title: Mean-variance portfolio selection: connections between mean-field systems and forward-backward stochastic systems under initial-terminal cost coupling
summary: This paper investigates the connection between mean-field systems and forward-backward stochastic systems arising from the mean-variance portfolio selection problem. By introducing the conditional expectation process of terminal wealth, the mean-field term is represented by a backward state, leading to a class of control problems for forward-backward stochastic systems with coupled initial-terminal values.
